method: Global residual-range restriction from normalized training class-mean contrasts, folded into native BF16 weights; inspired by concept erasure, not LEACE or its guarantees
positive_training: 520 existing original employment/neighbour scenarios in five task formats with pinned clean answers
negative_training: 104 independent authored nonemployment scenarios in the same five task formats;520 clean answers greedy96 batch16

positions: mean teacher-forced answer content tokens excluding terminator and padding

basis.row_normalization: unit L2 for each nonzero class mean difference
basis.fit: float64 thinSVD top4 right singular vectors; no diagnostic-driven rank selection

native_edit.embedding: E_new=E(I-VV^T), tied output head follows embedding
native_edit.branch_writes: A=D V;Q=orth(A);W_new=W-Q(Q^T W) for all34 attention o_proj and MLP down_proj
native_edit.normalization_scale: D=1+stored RMSNorm weight; never invert D
native_edit.projection_arithmetic: FP32 with TF32 disabled; one BF16 cast

gates.before_candidate: source/data pins, actual CPU/CUDA math tests, capture mask checks, finite rank4 basis and closure<=8, native publication and tied reload checks
gates.geometry: Report fit and held-out format contrast energy captured; no threshold chosen after reading values and no semantic claim from energy alone
gates.arithmetic: Precast constraint and Pythagorean relative errors<=1e-5; actual BF16 forward leakage measured at every layer and final norm
gates.behavior: quick40 plus contextual12 development regressions first; all target-bearing responses reviewed for meaningful concept retention and controls for damage; only survivors progress to broad/PPL/scalar and an untouched final audit

cumulative: A successful single edit must progress to actual sequential concept+neighbour removals and a measured damage curve. Future global bases should union old/new erased directions and rebuild from clean with unchanged norm scales. Rank count alone does not show31-removal safety.
limitations: Mean contrasts may encode task/style/theme differences
Projection can reroute nonlinear computations and change RMS normalization gains
Linear geometric removal does not establish semantic deletion
No previous sprint candidate qualifies; global goal remains active
